{{Quote|One proposal I'm personally advancing is the construction of a new, peacetime praxeum at the Abhean Shipyards. It will be called the ''Sunburris'' and will stretch two kilometers long and one kilometer wide. It will be a sight to behold.|Crix Sunburris, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Sunburris''''' was a proposed [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]] envisioned by the [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]]. It was eventually realized as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]''.<ref name="JP" />
